nodes.name: Vulnerability Scanning
nodes.prompt_template: Run security scans on the repository using run_security_scanner. Catalog all issues with CWE IDs.

verification_gate.verifier_prompt: Audit scan outputs and confirm all discovered vulnerabilities are logged.

nodes.name: Mitigation Plan & Patch Drafting
nodes.prompt_template: Run create-security-implementation-plan and draft safe code patches in sandboxed branches.

verification_gate.verifier_prompt: Verify branch workspace compiles cleanly without syntax errors.

nodes.name: Proof-of-Concept Verification
nodes.prompt_template: Execute run_poc against patched code to verify vulnerabilities are no longer exploitable.

verification_gate.verifier_prompt: Verify run_poc output confirms zero exploitability.

nodes.name: Consolidated Audit Report
nodes.prompt_template: Merge verified branch patches and generate consolidated security report via generate-security-audit-report.

verification_gate.verifier_prompt: Verify audit report rendered and EVIDENCE.md recorded.
